name: Spaced
s: Surreal cult sitcom starring Simon Pegg and Jessica Stevenson, with more pop culture references than you can shake a light sabre at.

paragraphs.text: Spaced is a British television sitcom created, written by and starring Simon Pegg and Jessica Stevenson, and directed by Edgar Wright. The show follows Daisy Steiner and Tim Bisley, two Londoners in their twenties who, despite having only just met, decide to move into a flat offered for a 'professional couple' after Daisy gives up on squatting and Tim is kicked out by his ex-girlfriend. Supporting roles include Nick Frost as Tim's best friend Mike, Katy Carmichael as Daisy's best friend Twist, Mark Heap as lodger Brian who lives downstairs and Julia Deakin as landlady Marsha.

The first series of the show, comprising seven episodes, premiered in the UK on Channel 4 on 24 September 1999, and the second and final series, also consisting of seven episodes, started on 23 February 2001 and concluded on 13 April.
Both series were nominated for the BAFTA TV Award for Best Situation Comedy. Spaced has been cited as one of one of the best television series of all time.
